post.description:
Needs the `password` and, with two-factor on, `code` (authenticator or recovery code); wrong or missing: 422 on the field. Closes
the account at once: profile and vehicles disappear everywhere, QR stickers stop working, every device is signed out, follows
end. Messages stay for the other side as "Gelöschtes Mitglied". Everything is deleted for good within 30 days; there is no way back,
and signing in answers as for an unknown account. Open under every restriction. The same deletion as /konto-loeschen (WEB-05).

post.description:
Needs the current `password` (422 on `password` when wrong) and, with two-factor on, a current `code` (TOTP or recovery code;
missing: 422 `two_factor_code_required`, wrong: 422 on `code`). The same 202 whether or not the new address has an account: a free
address gets a six-digit code, valid 10 minutes; a taken one gets nothing, and its owner is told someone tried. Nothing is sent
during the cooldown of `resend_after_seconds` or above the code budget (5 an hour, 10 a day). 422 on `email` for the current
address.

now, or had one when the code was asked for: 422 on `email`, "Diese Adresse kann nicht verwendet werden.", and the change ends.

post.description:
`current_password` wrong: 422 on it. With two-factor on, a current `code` too (TOTP or recovery code; missing: 422
`two_factor_code_required`, wrong: 422 on `code`). The new `password` follows the policy of 02_PRODUCT_SPEC §3.1 (each broken rule its own
message) and must differ from the current one and the username. This device stays signed in. Other browsers are signed out by any
password change; with `revoke_other_sessions: true` the app on every other device too (its push tokens go with it). A security
mail and an in-app notice follow.

details.description:
By type, language-free. Named details, not data: Laravel (and the export) leave a single resource unwrapped when its
body already has a key "data". followed_published: {kind: "vehicle"|"update", update_id, vehicles, updates} (kind of the latest
event; how many builds were published and updates posted that day). build_saved: {count, week} ("2026-W45"). security:
{event: "new_device"|"password_changed"|"email_changed"|"two_factor_changed"|"deletion_requested"|"sessions_revoked"|"verification_failed"|"recovery_code_used", device_name, security_event_id (M4.7: the SET-21 row of a login alert, else null)}.
new_follower: {}. moderation_decision (a decision about the reader's content or account): {decision_id, action:
"remove_content"|"restrict"|"suspend"}. report_decided (the outcome of a case the reader reported): {decision_id, outcome:
"no_action"|"remove_content"|"measures"}, never the measure. SAFE-01 opens the decision.
qr_milestone [SIG]: {milestone: 10|50|100|500|1000}, total scans of the vehicle's stickers; QR-02 opens. hu_au_reminder [SIG]:
{due: "2027-03"}, the month the HU/AU is due; GAR-06 opens. catalog_request (M3.3): {outcome: "accepted"|"rejected", requested:
the make and model the member typed, reason: why it was declined (rejected only), else null}; the vehicle is the member's own.
support_reply (Phase 3): {ticket_id, reference: "SC-7H2KQXMB"}, the team answered that support request; SET-15b opens the
thread. Never the text of the answer. M4.11: reaction {target: "vehicle"|"build_update", update_id} (the owner's own item;
actors are who reacted, never how), mention {update_id, comment_id} (comment_id null for a mention in the update itself),
comment [build_comments] {update_id, comment_id (the newest), reply: a reply to the reader's comment}, vehicle_follower {}
(vehicle is the reader's build). update_id is null once the reader may no longer see the update; the row then opens the build.
M4.12 (the event is in `event`): event_review {outcome: "approved"|"rejected", reason (rejected only)}, event_promoted {} (the
reader moved from the waitlist to going), event_reminder {kind: "24h"|"2h"}, event_update {kind: "update"|"changed" (time or
place changed), update_id}, event_cancelled {by_staff}. Never the text of an update. M4.13 maintenance_due (vehicle: the
reader's own): {kind: "date"|"km", item_id, item_type, due_on (YYYY-MM-DD) or due_km, lead_days, reminder_key (the id of the
app's local backup notification, also in the push data)}; MNT-01 opens. M4.14 (in-app only): business_review {outcome:
"verified"|"rejected"|"suspended"|"reinstated", business_id, reason (rejected and suspended only)}, BIZ-03 opens; business_tag
{state: "requested"|"accepted"|"declined", side: "business" (the business must act or hears back; BIZ-04 opens) | "member" (the
build's owner; VEH-02 opens), tag_id, business_id, mod_id} (vehicle: the build of the mod).

anyOf.description: Where sign-up began, when it began on a QR scan or a public page (ADR-216): qr, public_vehicle, public_profile.

items.description: What is new, one sentence each.

errors.description: Messages by field; empty when the error is not about one field.

device_id.description: The app's per-install id, as sent at sign-in. Taken only by a token that has none yet (an older app build's).

app_version.description: M4.7 (09 §8.4): the app and system version now, so SET-06 shows them after an update.

cost_public.description: Always false since M4.9 (09 §11, ADR ruling): costs are never public. Kept for older apps.

legal_status.description: Null while the flag sig.mod_legal_status is off.

notes.description: The owner's, null for anybody else (ADR-142).

fields.description: The stored values, for the owner's form.

legal_disclaimer.description: "Angaben des Besitzers, keine rechtliche Prüfung", when a legal status is shown.

GAR-07 shows a vehicle's, delete only (DELETE media/{id}); media:prune removes them after 30 days. Never in `photos`.

search.description:

only when it is a catalogue brand, the diameter only for wheels, type only for suspension.

product.description: M4.14 (09 §8.9): the linked catalogue product (BRD-02, "Builds mit {Produkt}"), or null. Null while parts_catalogue is off.

installed_by.description:
M4.14 (09 §8.10): "Eingebaut von", only once the business and the owner both confirmed it and the reader may see the
business; null otherwise. Null while businesses is off.

business_tag.description: The owner's alone (null for anybody else): the state of the tag while it waits or after the business declined it.

history_recorded.description: Whether Verlauf now tells about this edit. Decides between "Gespeichert" and "Im Verlauf erscheint ein Eintrag".

eyebrow.description: "NISSAN". Null while a draft has no make.

make.description: Catalogue name or free text. Null while a draft has no make.

model.description: Catalogue name or free text. Null while a draft has no model.

spec_strip.description: Four columns: power and torque in the viewer's units, model year, drivetrain. value is null until entered.

updates_count.description: M4.9: the owner's own count of Verlauf entries (hidden ones included); null for anybody else, so no number reaches others.

is_sample.description: Sample content (09 §8.19): the app shows the "Beispiel" badge.

wizard.description: Where a draft resumes: "Entwurf · Schritt 2 von 4". Null for anything but the owner's draft.

qr.description: Owner only. The vehicle's active code, from its first publish on.

anyOf.description:
The owner row. Null for everybody but the owner when the owner asked not to be named on the vehicle page
(`show_owner_on_qr`, ADR-148 a), so a card does not name who the page itself hides.

latest_update.description: The newest entry of Verlauf that is not hidden, in one line: "Fahrwerk: Serie → KW V3 · −35 mm".

viewer.description:
M4.8: the reader's own state on this build: saved in one of their collections, their private reaction
("strong" | "clean" | "low" | "loud", null while build_reactions is off). Null for guests. Never anybody else's, never a count.

saved_at.description: When the member saved the build, ISO 8601.

chips.description:
Discover filter chips (DISC-02): `facet` is a filter parameter (make, model, generation, year_min, year_max, power_min,
power_max, drivetrain, gearbox, fuel, wheel_diameter, wheel_brand, suspension_type, suspension_brand, exhaust_brand,
mod_category), `value` its value as the search takes it (a slug, an enum value, a number), `label` what the chip shows.
Applied as normal, editable chips. May be empty.

label.description: "KI-Vorschlag" (EU AI Act Art. 50), in the request's language.

query.description: The query as it was searched, trimmed.

vehicles.description: `count` stops at 1000; `count_capped` true means there are more: show "1000+".

members.description: `count` stops at 1000; `count_capped` true means there are more: show "1000+".

The M1.8 relevance of the typed words, then the build changed last. | | `newest`
First published, newest first. | | `updated`
Last visible change (specs, mods, photos), newest first, as Neue Builds on HOME-01. | | `power`
Power in PS, most first; builds without a power figure last. |

SecondFactorRequest.title: SecondFactorRequest

SecureAccountLinkRequest.title: SecureAccountLinkRequest

SecureAccountRequest.title: SecureAccountRequest

ticket_reference.description: The support request that was opened ("SC-7H2KQXMB").

password_reset_required.description: The next sign-in with the password asks for a new one by e-mail code.

removed.description:
What was removed because it was added since the reported sign-in (SEC-M47-01): passkeys and provider links (counts), a pending
e-mail change, and a second factor turned on since then. The app lists them on the confirmation.

SecurityActivity.description: The rows of SET-21 Sicherheitsaktivität (09 §7.9, §8.4): what a member sees of their member_security_events. Several audit actions can share a row type (both locks are `sign_in_locked`); bookkeeping events (registration, token rotation, renames) are not shown.
SecurityActivity.title: SecurityActivity

this_device.description: The app install of this request.

approx_city.description: "München": approximate, only with a GeoLite2 database (OA-33).

anyOf.description: How the member signed in (sign-in rows).

by_staff.description: Done by the SPEED CLUB team (e.g. sessions ended by support).

details.description:
What else the row names: `provider` (apple, google), `passkey_provider` (iCloud-Schlüsselbund, …), `count` and `steps`
{password, email_code, second_factor} of failed attempts with `last_at`, `devices` and `sessions` signed out, `recovery_codes_left`.

can_secure.description: Offers "Das war ich nicht" (POST me/security/secure with this id).

body.description: The text of a text message, at most 2000 characters.

reply_to_id.description:
SM11 reply (ADR-445): the id of a message of this conversation you can see. A message you deleted for yourself, one before
your clearing point or one that is gone is 422.
